scope: Final engineering acceptance audit of candidate compiler/runtime/learning; no manuscript changes.

findings.original: JitSession accepted tuple type names but sent t32 text to dec_literal, whose ABI admits only int/bool/str literals.
findings.reproducer:
with JitSession('Dec ident(x) -> r:
    (t32 x) -> t32 r:
        r = x
Dec main() -> r:
    () -> int r:
        r = 0
') as j: print(j.run(function='ident',args=[('t32','5')]))
findings.repair: Foreign t1/t32/q4/ratio entry values now use checked native conversion builtins. Ratio text parser accepts exact N/D or integer text and rejects malformed input.
Normalize a validated leading plus sign before calling the GMP-backed integer constructor; explicit +2/+3 now tested as 2/3.

findings.reproducer: Train five (100,70) cost pairs; save; change generic costs to [100]*32 while optimized stays [70]*5; recompute payload SHA256; load and choose.
findings.disposition: Owner confirmed repaired and frozen before benchmark run04; final acceptance evidence owned by profile_learning/root.

findings.kind: source inspection; no observed failing production run
findings.original: Runtime and object cache files were written directly without interprocess locking. Simultaneous first builds could observe incomplete artifacts.
findings.repair: Linux flock serializes publishers; runtime libraries/objects/manifests and generated object/IR/manifests are staged, fsynced and atomically replaced.
findings.test: Three real subprocesses share an initially empty runtime directory and object cache, execute the same compiled program and obtain the same object digest.

findings.original: benchmark_native.reference stripped the line prefix from runtime-error text while native runtime and adapt_native.reference retain it.
findings.impact: All seven measured workloads succeed, so existing successful benchmark results are unaffected; future negative benchmark inputs could be incorrectly rejected.
findings.disposition: Owner confirmed repaired and frozen before benchmark run04; final acceptance evidence owned by profile_learning/root.

acceptance_scope_notes: Core semantic evidence combines independent runtime properties, supplied reference comparisons and actual AOT/ORC execution; no exhaustive proof of every possible source is claimed.
Native entry specialization guards implementation identity; this is not speculative input-range optimization or mid-function deoptimization.
Held-out performance observations are later windows of the same seven programs, not unseen programs. All measured preparation/profiling costs remain part of the negative benefit conclusion.
Profile causal influence uses explicitly labelled synthetic costs and actual subsequent native dispatch; this fixture does not support a speedup claim.
Unrecoverable system allocator/GMP exhaustion is fail-stop; runtime deterministic value-allocation failures are tested separately.
Self-hosting, AArch64 execution and grammar extensions beyond original core v1 remain unsupported.
